subject: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options
messages:
From: James Todd <jtodd@aurorahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-risk@aurorahealth.com, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options

Hi Evelyn,

Aurora Health is wrapping up our vendor risk assessment for outbound LLM services. Could you send us the most recent penetration test report for Redwood's hosted API? We specifically need:
- the full report (redacted as appropriate),
- an executive summary for our compliance team, and
- a short remediation status showing which findings are open/closed (we track by CVE/issue id).

We can sign a mutual NDA first if Redwood requires it for the full report. Also — what secure transfer options do you support? Our security team prefers SFTP or an encrypted bundle; presigned S3 links are acceptable if the key exchange is out-of-band.

A couple of additional notes from our questionnaire: we have a high-severity item in our tracker referencing CVE-2026-1234 — can you confirm whether that was addressed in the latest remediation cycle? If not, please include a mitigation timeline.

We aim to complete this vendor review by next Friday; please let me know an ETA and any docs we should sign.

Thanks,
James Todd
Director, Vendor Risk — Aurora Health
jtodd@aurorahealth.com
O: 415-555-0190

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: James Todd <jtodd@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options

Hi James — thanks for the note and the heads-up on CVE-2026-1234. Happy to get you everything you need. We have three common secure sharing workflows; pick whichever matches your procurement/security policy and we'll proceed:

1) NDA + encrypted presigned S3 bundle (recommended for speed)
   - We send a DocuSign NDA link; once signed we upload an encrypted ZIP (AES-256) to a presigned S3 URL (72h expiry).
   - We send the symmetric key via a separate channel (e.g., your security team's secure chat or phone).

2) Vendor evidence portal (recommended for ongoing partnerships)
   - Give your security team read-only access to our evidence portal where reports, exec summaries, and remediation trackers are viewable. Access is time-limited and audited.

3) SFTP with one-time credentials (required by some customers)
   - We can drop an encrypted package on an SFTP server and provide short-lived credentials.

Notes on redaction and content: we typically remove internal IPs, host-level logs with customer data, and certain operational runbooks. We do not redact items that are required for technical verification (e.g., vulnerability titles, impacted components), but we can do additional redaction on request. Please indicate if Aurora requires tenant-specific redactions.

Attached is our standard NDA template (NDA_Redwood_2027.pdf). I’ve cc’d Marissa (Customer Security Lead) and Karthik (Security Engineering) so they can prepare the remediations summary and technical notes.

ETA: If you select option (1) or (3) and return the signed NDA within 24 hours, we can provide the encrypted report and remediation summary within 48 hours after receipt. If you prefer the portal onboarding, that typically takes 2 business days to provision.

DocuSign link (NDA): https://app.docusign.com/ABC-Redwood-NDA-2027

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Phone: 650-555-0227

Attachments:
- NDA_Redwood_2027.pdf (template)

From: James Todd <jtodd@aurorahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@aurorahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 12:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options

Thanks, Evelyn — we signed the NDA via the DocuSign link a few minutes ago (should be routed back to you automatically).

Aurora prefers SFTP for this transfer due to our internal controls, but presigned S3 with out-of-band key exchange would also work if SFTP is not possible. Can you confirm:
- whether you can provide SFTP delivery, and if so what the host and retention policy will be;
- if S3, whether the encryption key will be delivered by phone or our secure Slack;
- whether you can include a CSV remediation tracker keyed to the CVE/issue id (we need to import this into our vendor tooling).

Also please confirm status for CVE-2026-1234. If it was not fully addressed, we need planned remediation dates.

Olivia (cc'd) is our technical contact and will coordinate SFTP details.

Regards,
James

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 13:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options — action items (internal)

Marissa / Karthik — FYI, Aurora signed the NDA and prefer SFTP but will accept presigned S3 if necessary. Please: 

- Marissa: prepare the remediation CSV keyed to our internal finding IDs + CVE mapping. Include current status (open/mitigated/monitor), dates, and owner. Put a short public-friendly note for each high/critical item.
- Karthik: confirm whether CVE-2026-1234 was fully remediated in the last release. If not, provide the mitigation plan and expected completion date. Also confirm what we will redact (if anything) in the full report for customer consumption.

Once you both sign off I will: upload the encrypted ZIP to SFTP (or presigned S3 if SFTP is blocked) and send credentials/key out-of-band. Aim: 48 hours after NDA receipt.

Thanks — Evelyn

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: James Todd <jtodd@aurorahealth.com>
Cc: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@aurorahealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: latest penetration test report and secure transfer options

Hi James / Olivia —

Thanks — we received your signed NDA. Update and next steps: 

1) Transfer method: Redwood can provision an SFTP drop with one-time credentials by tomorrow morning (UTC). If Aurora decides to use S3 instead we will send a presigned S3 URL valid for 72 hours and transmit the AES-256 key via the phone number on the NDA or your secure Slack. Please confirm SFTP host preference or confirm S3.

2) Package contents (what you'll receive):
   - redwood-pt-exec-summary-2027.pdf (executive summary)
   - redwood-pt-full-report-2027.pdf (redacted where appropriate)
   - remediation-tracker-aurora-view.csv (CSV keyed to CVE/finding id)
   - redwood-pt-package-2027.zip.gpg (AES-256 encrypted archive; file is in GPG format)

3) CVE-2026-1234: Marissa / Karthik confirmed this was mitigated in 2027-06 release. The remediation-tracker CSV will include the fix commit reference and deployment date. If you need packet-level artifacts or proof-of-fix steps we can schedule a short tech call with Karthik.

4) Redaction: The full report will have hostnames/IPs redacted and will exclude raw host logs or customer-derived data. We will leave vulnerability titles, affected components, and proof-of-concept descriptions intact. If Aurora requires additional redaction, let us know now so we can apply before delivery.

Links and artifacts:
- Evidence portal (read-only, if you want ongoing access): https://redwood.sharepoint.com/sites/security-evidence/aurora-DEAL-8923
- DocuSign confirmation: https://app.docusign.com/ABC-Redwood-NDA-2027 (we have your signature)

Please reply with your preferred transfer method (SFTP or S3) and the best phone number for a one-time key exchange. Once we have that we'll schedule the transfer and send credentials.

Best regards,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Customer Security — Redwood Inference
evelyn.hart@redwood.com
Phone: 650-555-0227

Attachments (to be uploaded after method selection):
- redwood-pt-package-2027.zip.gpg (encrypted)
- remediation-tracker-aurora-view.csv
- redwood-pt-exec-summary-2027.pdf
